title: Last Stone Weight II
description: Partition stones into two piles to minimize the difference between their total weights.
pseudocode:
1. total = sum(stones)
2. target = floor(total / 2)
3. dp = new Array(target + 1).fill(false)
4. dp[0] = true
5. for stone in stones:
6.   for j from target down to stone:
7.     dp[j] = dp[j] || dp[j - stone]

steps.note: Calculate total sum of stones [2, 4, 1]. Total = 7.
Initialize dp array of size 4 [true, false, false, false].
After stone 2: dp[2] becomes true. dp = [true, false, true, false]
After stone 1: dp[3] becomes true. dp = [true, true, true, true]
